verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only inbound APIs (track, bulk track, identify, account properties, user deletion), plus report alerts and emailing replays. None of these are registrable outbound HTTP callbacks that a programmatic consumer can subscribe to. Webhooks are a fair axis for an analytics platform, so the lack of evidence makes this 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
